subject: Security & hosting path — BAA / SOC2 evidence and VPC/on-prem options
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthops.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tbecker@healthops.com>, Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@healthops.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from today’s discovery call

Kimberly —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Helpful to walk through Redwood’s runtime and options at a high level. A few things we need to clarify from our side so we can make a hosting recommendation internally: 

- BAA: HealthOps handles PHI and needs a signed BAA before any production access. Is Redwood able to execute a standard BAA and do you have an estimated turnaround?
- SOC2 evidence: our security team will ask for SOC2 Type II report or a SOC2 summary. What artifacts can you provide (redacted report / summary / controls matrix)?
- Deployment modes: we prefer Private VPC or on‑prem if possible, but want to understand the tradeoffs (cost, timeline, audit access). Can you provide a short comparison and the typical lead time for a VPC vs Dedicated capacity vs on‑prem?

Also tagging Ellen (counsel) and Tom (infra) so they can call out anything I missed. Can you send a short post-call checklist / next-steps doc that we can use to align legal and infra?

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director, Product Operations
HealthOps Inc
agomez@healthops.com
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthops.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tbecker@healthops.com>, Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@healthops.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today’s discovery call

Alicia —

Great talking with you and the HealthOps team. I captured the main asks below and attached a short packet to get the security review started. Attachments: Redwood_Security_Pack_v3.pdf, VPC_Deployment_Playbook.docx.

Summary / immediate next steps:
1) BAA — Yes, Redwood signs a standard BAA. I’ll loop Legal if HealthOps wants to start the signature flow; typical turnaround is 3–7 business days after redlines.
2) SOC2 evidence — See attached SOC2 summary (we redact customer data). We can provide the SOC2 Type II report under an NDA or a secure ShareFile link if required.
3) Preferred hosting path — Based on the call: HealthOps prefers Private VPC or on‑prem because of PHI. Short comparator below; I’ll ask our infra/security team for lead times:
   - Hosted API: fastest to production (days), limited for PHI unless paired with BAA + contractual controls; lower cost.
   - Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools, good isolation, faster than full on‑prem (2–6 weeks) and supports BAA.
   - Private VPC / On‑prem: strongest isolation/auditability, supports on‑site attestations, longer setup (4–10+ weeks depending on network approvals).

Ask: can you confirm who on your team will lead the procurement/tech onboarding (Ellen or Tom)? I’ll set up a short mutual action plan (MAP) and include the SOC2 artifacts and a deployment checklist.

Looping in Marissa (solutions) and Rishi (security) internally to validate scope and timeline.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_Security_Pack_v3.pdf
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthops.com>, Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@healthops.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick follow-up from today’s discovery call — HealthOps (BAA / SOC2 / VPC)

Team —

Forwarding HealthOps’ recap and my summary. Key asks: BAA execution, SOC2 artifacts, and a clear timeline + MAP for Private VPC or on‑prem flow. HealthOps prefers Private VPC / on‑prem for PHI; Tom is infra lead, Ellen is legal counsel.

Can you do the following: 
- Rishi: confirm what SOC2 artifacts we can share immediately and whether we need an NDA / ShareFile link. Also flag any controls that typically require customer involvement for attestations.
- Marissa: please draft a one‑page MAP for the two deployment tracks (VPC and Dedicated) with expected timelines and milestone owners. Keep it high level — HealthOps wants something they can share with legal and procurement.
- Vivek: note any potential infra blockers for Private VPC (network peering, IP allowlists, audit access) and an estimated setup window.

Target: send an internal draft to me by EOD Monday so I can share with HealthOps on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Kim
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthops.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick follow-up from today’s discovery call — HealthOps (BAA / SOC2 / VPC)

Kim / team —

Short answers from security side: 
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide the SOC2 Type II summary (redacted) immediately — attached SOC2-Type-II-Summary-2027.pdf. Full SOC2 report can be delivered under an NDA/secure link. We also have a controls matrix that maps Redwood controls to common questions (I’ll attach that to the MAP).
- BAA: legal ok to sign standard BAA. For redlines > minimal we route to Legal (2–5 business days).
- Audit access / attestations: For Private VPC/on‑prem deployments we can support auditor access with a scoped attestation; exact process depends on customer controls and whether the customer wants on‑site or remote evidence review. Estimate: plan 2–4 weeks to schedule evidence transfer once contract and MSA are in place.

Open items for HealthOps to confirm: 
1) Will HealthOps accept a redacted SOC2 summary initially, or do you require the full report before design kickoff?
2) Any specific regulatory requirements beyond HIPAA (e.g., state-level rules) we should be aware of?

I’ll add the controls matrix and a proposed set of evidence artifacts to the MAP.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Attachment: SOC2-Type-II-Summary-2027.pdf
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthops.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tbecker@healthops.com>, Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@healthops.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today’s discovery call

Thanks — this is really helpful. A few quick confirmations from our side: 
- We are OK starting with the redacted SOC2 summary for initial technical review; procurement / legal may request the full report later under an NDA.
- HealthOps will require a signed BAA before production keys are issued. Please route the BAA to Ellen and me when convenient.
- Our preference is Private VPC if the timeline and cost are reasonable. If Redwood can outline the MAP and provide the controls matrix + SOC2 summary, Tom and I will run that through infra and legal next week.

If you can send the one‑page MAP and the controls matrix by Tuesday EOD that would be ideal. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alicia
